lines.text: Ahh. / Here we have / another job applicant. / Desperately hoping / to pay their rent. / Poor fool. / They must have forgotten / it is 2026.
The application / has sensed / a candidate. / ATS turrets rise.
The applicant / need not worry / about the shredded resume. / They will have to type it all in / by hand / anyway.
The applicant / must turn the volume / all the way up.
The company / gently collects / the applicant / for an unpaid assessment.
They declare themselves human. / The form / takes that as a threat.
The applicant / is ready to give up. / There is no salary listed. / No guarantee / their resume / makes it past the ATS. / Their hand moves / to close the Chrome tab.
But then / they remember / their student loans.
They turn back. / One more round.
After careful consideration, / the company / has decided / to move forward / with other candidates.
